_readme: Accepted npm-audit findings, keyed by GHSA advisory id — never by package name,
so a different future vulnerability in the same package still fails the gate.
An entry belongs here only when the finding does not apply to how BamDude actually

The gate prints every accepted finding on each run, and warns when an entry no
longer matches anything (dependency updated past it) so the list cannot silently rot.
